title: Affine tensor-homology chart comparison is natural
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], N a quasi-coherent O_Y-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and for each affine open U let MA_U, NA_U be modules over A_U=Gamma(Y,U), with a specified linear equivalence sN_U:NA_U -> Gamma(U,N) and a projective resolution P_U of MA_U. Fix n in N, an inclusion V subset U and its ring map phi. Suppose b:NA_U -> NA_V is phi-semilinear, a:P_U -> Res_phi P_V is a chain map and k:P_U tensor NA_U -> Res_phi(P_V tensor NA_V) is a chain map. Assume sN_V(b(y))=res_N(sN_U(y)) and k_j(x tensor y)=a_j(x) tensor b(y). Let f_U identify the associated sheaf of H_n(P_U tensor NA_U) with H^{-n}(tilde(P_U extended to nonpositive cochain degrees) tensor N[0] restricted to U), using exact associated-sheaf homology and the normalized coefficient isomorphism. Let beta be the tensor of the extended sheafification of a and restriction of N[0]. Let t=H_n(k) followed by the exact restriction-of-scalars homology isomorphism, and v be inverse exact-open-restriction homology followed by H^{-n}(beta). Then Res_phi(f_U) followed by v equals the associated semilinear map of t followed by f_V.

proof.text: Use the canonical associated-sheaf tensor isomorphism and its pure-tensor formula. The adjunction characterizes a map out of an associated sheaf by its values on the canonical sections. Thus hb identifies the coefficient square, and hk identifies the tensor square in each degree -j. In positive degrees the extended first factors are zero. This gives the square for tensorResolutionChartTensorIso; no arbitrary isomorphism supplied by an existence theorem is used.

Apply homology to that chain square. The canonical exact-functor homology comparisons are natural: use ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality, or tensorResolutionSemilinearMap_homologyData with the chosen left homology data. Extension of a chain complex to degrees -j carries the same kernel, cokernel and induced homology map, as expressed by tensorResolutionExtendHomologyMapData and tensorResolutionExtendedHomology_naturality. Compose these equations with tensorResolutionChartHomologyIso_hom. The inverse restriction-homology comparison is on the source side, while H_n(k) is followed by the forward restriction-of-scalars homology comparison on the coefficient side. Associativity and inverse cancellation give the displayed equation.

theorem tensorResolutionChartHomologyIso_naturality
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (N : Y.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (MA NA : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u))
    (sN : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, NA U ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] N.val.obj (op U.1))
    (P : ∀ U, ProjectiveResolution (MA U))
    (n : ℕ)
    (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
    (b : NA U →ₛₗ[(Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom] NA V)
    (a : (P U).complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
        (P V).complex)
    (k : ((tensorRight (NA U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj (P U).complex ⟶
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.down ℕ)).obj
        (((tensorRight (NA V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj (P V).complex))
    (hb : ∀ y : NA U,
      sN V (b y) = N.val.map (homOfLE h).op (sN U y))
    (hk : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : (P U).complex.X j) (y : NA U),
      k.f j (x ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, U.1)] y) =
        (show (P V).complex.X j from a.f j x) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, V.1)] (b y)) :
    let φ := Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
    let LB := ((tensorRight (NA V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj (P V).complex
    let t := HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n ≫
      ((LB.sc n).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.hom)).hom
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)).map
        (tensorResolutionChartHomologyIso N U (MA U) (NA U) (sN U) (P U) n).hom ≫
        (((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor (tensorResolutionChartComplex U (MA U) (P U))
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N))
          (curriedTensor (Spec Γ(Y, U.1)).Modules)).sc (-(n : ℤ))).mapHomologyIso
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ))).inv ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (tensorResolutionRestrictionTensorMap (Spec.map φ)
            (tensorResolutionChartComplex U (MA U) (P U))
            (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N))
            (tensorResolutionChartComplex V (MA V) (P V))
            (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N))
            (tensorResolutionSemilinearComplexMap φ (.up ℤ)
              ((P U).complex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
              ((P V).complex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
              (tensorResolutionExtendSemilinear φ.hom ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat
                (P U).complex (P V).complex a))
            (tensorResolutionChartRestrictionComplexIso Y V U h
              ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N)).hom) (-(n : ℤ)) =
      tensorResolutionSemilinearMap φ t ≫
        (tensorResolutionChartHomologyIso N V (MA V) (NA V) (sN V) (P V) n).hom
